newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds prices lower, trade stagnate.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds prices lower, trade stagnate.

text.p: Lower UK meals and feeds prices failed to attract buyers on Tuesday.
"It's the same old story people are covered and only buying hand-to-mouth," said one broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was down around one stg in the forward positions while nearby months were unchanged.
Rapemeal from the Erith mill was unchanged while material from Liverpool, old and new crop, was one to four stg down and Hull new crop was one to two stg lower.
Sunflower meals and pellets were unchanged while corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged to three stg lower.
